All five are implemented in `problems.py` and verified:

- `parse_duration` — `re.fullmatch` with optional `h`/`m`/`s` groups in order; raises `ValueError` on non-strings, empty matches, bad order, duplicates, negatives, whitespace, or trailing garbage.
- `luhn_valid` — strips spaces/hyphens, returns `False` on empty or non-digit input, then standard Luhn doubling from the right; never raises.
- `flatten` — recursive walk building joined keys; empty nested dicts vanish, non-dict values (lists included) pass through, input untouched.
- `top_k_frequent` — `Counter` + sort by `(-count, word)`; returns `[]` for `k <= 0` and all distinct words when `k` overshoots.
- `rolling_max` — monotonic deque of indices, O(n); `ValueError` for `window <= 0`, `[]` when `window > len(nums)`.

Throwaway checks covered every docstring example plus edge cases (invalid inputs, tie-breaks, empty inputs, duplicates) and a 300k-element timing run at 0.11s. No test files left behind, no commits.
